scope: PCTOM-R2 Phase 2 audit mutation and evidence-claim integrity

invariants.description: Audit receipts that name a parent artifact hash must match the current parent bytes.
Audit receipts may not be rebound from their expected parent artifact class to another archive object.
Archive manifest children must be present, hash-correct, size-correct, complete, and unique.
Phase 2 acceptance evidence may not downgrade schema identifiers to an older or unrecognized version.
Predecessor evidence can be recorded as context but cannot satisfy PCTOM-R2 acceptance rows.
Audit receipts must be created no earlier than the artifact whose state they audit.
PCTOM-R2 Phase 2 acceptance evidence must report zero provider, Memory, canonical, identity, source-memory, human-judgment, and LLM-judge side effects.
Fixture-backed receipts cannot claim live efficacy, provider execution, production readiness, or semantic dream quality.

proves: the PCTOM-R2 Phase 2 mutation suite has a frozen local invariant vocabulary
does_not_prove: that the mutation suite has been run
